title: T06f — First real lifecycle update on the Mac service
goal: Run one update through nodes lifecycle-inspect/apply on the owner-selected Mac and record the evidence
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: The owner runs an update plan to a reviewed later revision; the receipt shows backup, fetch, rehearse, checkout, dependencies, build, start and verify completed
Running build, data integrity and service ownership are checked after it; a refusal or uncertainty is recorded, not retried silently
validation: Owner-run copy-paste commands with expected results; receipt and doctor output; acceptance note
escalation: Any destructive restore, changed ownership or unresolved physical/worker effects requires explicit reconciliation; general restore remains F-062
